steps_csv-formatter_1Desc: Paste raw CSV text or upload a .csv file. The formatter automatically detects delimiters (comma, tab, semicolon) and handles quoted fields.
steps_csv-formatter_2Desc: Click Format to align columns and validate the CSV structure. Error rows are flagged if they have mismatched column counts or malformed quoting.
steps_csv-formatter_3Desc: Copy the formatted CSV or download as a cleaned .csv file. Ready for import into Excel, Google Sheets, databases, or data analysis tools.
